content.title: Are shops open today? Tesco, Co-op, Aldi and Sainsbury’s Easter Bank Holiday opening times revealed
content.text: THE Easter Bank Holiday weekend is here, but some of us still need to stock up on supplies and grab some last-minute chocolate eggs. So here’s everything you need to know about supermarket opening times across the four-day weekend. Sign up for the Money newsletter Thank you! Tesco is closed for one day in most of the UK over EasterCredit: Alamy Tesco Tesco is the UK’s biggest supermarket chain, with around 3,000 branches across the nation. Hours vary depending on location over the bank holiday weekend: England, Wales and Isle of Man: Good Friday: 6am – 10pm Easter Saturday: Normal hours Easter Sunday: Closed Easter Monday: 8am – 6pm read more on supermarkets Northern Ireland: Good Friday: Normal hours Easter Saturday: Normal hours Easter Sunday: Closed Easter Monday: 8am – 8pm Scotland: Good Friday: Normal hours Easter Saturday: Normal hours Easter Sunday: Normal hours Easter Monday: Normal hours Most read in Money To avoid disappointment, check out the Tesco store locator to confirm your local branch’s hours. EASTER OPENING TIMES LIVE – FOLLOW LATEST UPDATES Sainsbury’s Sainsbury’s hours vary from location to locationCredit: Alamy Sainsbury’s is Great Britain’s second-biggest supermarket chain, with roughly 1,400 locations. Many large stores are on reduced hours across the weekend, with reported opening times as follows: England and Wales: Good Friday: 7am – 11pm Easter Saturday: 7am – 11pm Easter Sunday: Closed Easter Monday: 8am – 8pm Scotland: Good Friday: 7am – 11pm Easter Saturday: 7am – 11pm Easter Sunday: Normal hours Easter Monday: 8am – 8pm However, Sainsbury’s website warns, “Our opening times over the bank holiday will vary dependent on each store,” so it’s always wise to check the Sainsbury’s store locator. Asda Asda has revealed business hours that apply to most of its larger stores over Easter Asda has over 1,100 stores across the UK, making it the nation’s third-largest chain. The company said that the following opening times “apply to most of our larger stores” over the Easter period: Good Friday: 7am – 10pm Easter Saturday: 7am – 10pm Easter Sunday: Closed Easter Monday: 8am – 10pm Use the Asda store locator to check your local branch’s hours. Aldi Aldi has consistent national hours over the Easter Bank HolidayCredit: Getty Aldi is the UK’s fourth largest supermarket chain with more than 1,000 locations. The German-owned discounter keeps things simple over Easter with consistent national hours. Here’s what to expect: Good Friday: 8am – 9pm Easter Saturday: 8am – 9pm Easter Sunday: Closed Easter Monday: 8am – 8pm You can use the Aldi store finder to confirm your local branch’s hours. Lidl Lidl’s stores in Scotland have different opening hours to those in the UK and IrelandCredit: martinrlee Lidl has around 1,000 stores nationwide, making it the fifth-biggest chain in the UK. Lidl confirmed the hours on some days, while guiding shoppers to its store finder for others: England and Wales Good Friday: Normal hours Easter Saturday: Normal hours Easter Sunday: Closed Easter Monday: Check local store Scotland Good Friday: 9am – 10pm Easter Saturday: Normal hours Easter Sunday: Normal hours Easter Monday: Check local store Morrisons Morrisons is closed on Easter Sunday in England and WalesCredit: Getty Morrisons has around 500 supermarkets across the UK. The majority follow the times below: England and Wales: Good Friday: 7am – 10pm (most stores, hours may vary) Easter Saturday: Normal hours Easter Sunday: Closed Easter Monday: 7am – 8pm Scotland: Good Friday: 7am – 10pm Easter Saturday: Normal hours Easter Sunday: Normal hours Easter Monday: Normal hours Check the Morrisons’ store finder to confirm your local branch. Co-op Co-op hasn’t revealed opening times for all of its UK locationsCredit: Alamy Co-op has the second-most locations in the UK, with more than 2,500. These are its official Easter Bank Holiday opening hours: Good Friday: 7am – 10pm Easter Saturday: 7am – 10pm Easter Sunday: Co-op convenience stores open 7am-10am; larger stores closed Easter Monday: 7am – 10pm You can also check the Co-op store locator before heading out to see if your local branch is open.
